metadata.title: Elastic knots: compactness, contact, and variational structure
metadata.abstract: We study bending-minimizing sequences of closed curves in a fixed knot class and the self-contact of their limits. A positive matrix-valued measure records a possible loss of curvature energy. Ambient variations, localized on arbitrary coincidence sets, force this measure to vanish and give strong convergence in $H^2$. We then derive the elastic equation on isolated strands and overlap bundles, describe the distribution that remains at contact, and prove balance and rigidity statements under their precise additional hypotheses. Equality in the bridge bound gives constant curvature. Combining strong compactness with quantitative competitors gives an alternative proof that elastic limits in classes with equal bridge and braid indices are covered circles. An independent recovery theorem identifies the strong $H^2$ closure with the regular $H^2$ part of the $C^1$ closure and also implies strong compactness. Finally, a whole-line contact model illustrates which estimates are needed for finer shape selection.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 弹性结的强紧性与接触结构
analysis.workSummary: 研究固定结类内弯曲能极小化序列，利用任意重合集局部化的环境变分消除曲率能损失测度，得到 H² 强收敛，并描述接触处的弹性方程与平衡。
techniques: 强 H² 恢复与接触模型
analysis.breakthrough: 将极限的自接触纳入变分结构，并给出桥数等于辫数时覆盖圆极限的另一证明。
analysis.limitations: 平衡与刚性结论仍有各自附加条件；覆盖圆结果限于指定结类指标相等情形。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
